grid_definition.rule: union per scale, deduplicated, k <= N

method: k* per task is the deepest FUSION rank among its required records, measured at full corpus depth. Every grid point is a threshold on those exact ranks, so the curves are exact rather than sampled, and linearity of k(N) is measured rather than assumed.
retrieval_only: S2 is not involved, no HRM was run, no rho was selected and no engineering target was set.
